description: Dedicated entries for named High Lords and territorial Dragon Lords.

entries.title: Ixaryth the Storm-Winged
entries.summary: A tempestuous blue High Lord rules coastal wildlands and oceanic floating islands for the Draconic Emperor.
body: Ixaryth is one of the Emperor's direct lieutenants, combining elemental authority with responsibility for lesser Dragon Lords across maritime territory.

entries.title: Krorithyx the Iron-Hide
entries.summary: An ancient black High Lord oversees corrupted marshes and lowlands beneath the Emperor's hierarchy.
body: Krorithyx serves as a direct draconic vassal and regional authority over dangerous wetland territories, lesser rulers, and the tribute they owe upward.

entries.title: Sylvekar the Verdant Keeper
entries.summary: A jealous green High Lord guards immense jungles and the treasures hidden within them.
body: Sylvekar represents a verdant draconic lineage among the Emperor's highest vassals and maintains order over jungle domains through territorial power and guarded wealth.

entries.title: Kaldryxis the Infernal Sovereign
entries.summary: A red Dragon Lord rules volcanic badlands cut by lava rivers and ash storms.
body: Kaldryxis governs a domain whose destructive terrain reflects red-dragon fire and severity. Settlements survive through tribute, preparation, and avoidance of both ruler and landscape.

entries.title: Vaelyth the Frostfang
entries.summary: A white Dragon Lord dominates frozen lakes, glacial peaks, and icy caverns.
body: Vaelyth's tundra domain is shaped by cold, isolation, and difficult movement. Mortal subjects face the demands of both a territorial dragon and a punishing frozen environment.

entries.title: Zephyros the Stormcaller
entries.summary: A blue Dragon Lord rules a desert of perpetual sandstorms and ancient ruins.
body: Zephyros controls a domain where visibility, navigation, and access to buried history are shaped by endless storms. Tribute and survival both depend on reliable routes through the wastes.

entries.title: Myrilth the Verdant Tyrant
entries.summary: A green Dragon Lord claims a jungle filled with poisonous plants and dangerous wildlife.
body: Myrilth's power is reinforced by a living domain already hostile to intrusion. Subjects, hunters, and treasure-seekers must navigate both draconic authority and dense toxic ecology.

entries.title: Tharvix the Shadow-Wing
entries.summary: A black Dragon Lord controls acidic swamps, hidden bogs, and decaying ruins.
body: Tharvix's territory conceals routes, settlements, and old structures beneath murk and corrosive water. Fear of the ruler compounds the dangers of disease, ambush, and unstable ground.
